title: Split Array Into Fibonacci Sequence
description: Given a string of digits, split it into a Fibonacci-like sequence of at least 3 numbers.
pseudocode:
1. function backtrack(start, result):
2.   if start == len(S) and len(result) >= 3: return result
3.   for i in range(start, len(S)):
4.     num = stringToLong(S[start...i])
5.     if num > INT_MAX or (S[start] == '0' and i > start): break
6.     if len(result) < 2 or num == result[-1] + result[-2]:
7.       result.append(num)
8.       if backtrack(i + 1, result): return result
9.       result.pop()

steps.note: Sequence length >= 3 and end reached. Return result.
